rtg_observables.name: phase_differential
rtg_observables.source_rule: normalized control-or-phase coordinate when explicitly present; otherwise missing

rtg_observables.name: cadence_differential
rtg_observables.source_rule: normalized inverse spacing of ordered acquisition coordinates when available; otherwise missing

rtg_observables.name: authority_differential
rtg_observables.source_rule: fixed zero for a single governed experimental protocol unless a protocol-class change is explicitly encoded

rtg_observables.name: lineage_differential
rtg_observables.source_rule: zero within a published trace and one across non-composable source lineages; no inferred intermediate values

rtg_observables.name: route_differential
rtg_observables.source_rule: normalized experimental path or channel-setting difference when explicitly present; otherwise missing

rtg_observables.name: destination_differential
rtg_observables.source_rule: one minus a preregistered normalized transfer-quality observable; no test-derived scaling

rtg_observables.name: necessity
rtg_observables.source_rule: binary protocol-required indicator derived from experimental design, not outcome magnitude

rtg_observables.name: weighted_mismatch
rtg_observables.source_rule: sum_i w_i * delta_i^2 using weights fixed before locked-test release

rtg_observables.name: closure
rtg_observables.source_rule: binary record-completion indicator based on presence of the required experimental row fields

rtg_observables.name: recoverability
rtg_observables.source_rule: binary ability to reconstruct the canonical row and source lineage from the sealed manifest

normalization.degenerate_column_rule: map all non-missing values to zero

missing_data.numeric: retain missing marker; do not mean-impute
missing_data.rtg_activation: a row with a missing required observable is INDETERMINATE, not ALLOW or DENY
missing_data.row_deletion: forbidden except exact duplicate canonical rows

baseline_contracts.name: random_forest
baseline_contracts.fit: calibration with preregistered bounded grid selected on validation

scoring.advancement_rule: RTG must improve validation MAE over every baseline by at least 0.01 absolute without worse closure or recoverability
scoring.stop_rule: stop if mapping coverage is below 0.70 or any baseline class cannot be implemented from published fields
